description: Run when a Flow job reaches a terminal state.
examples: Connect Flow to the actions that should run after the job finishes.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when the job reaches a terminal state.

outputs.name: event.job
outputs.description: Returns the completed job reference.

outputs.name: event.job_id
outputs.description: Returns the stable job identifier.

outputs.name: event.job_kind
outputs.description: Returns the job kind.

outputs.name: event.job_owner
outputs.description: Returns the owner associated with the job.

outputs.name: event.job_state
outputs.description: Returns the terminal job state.

outputs.name: event.job_progress
outputs.description: Returns normalized job progress.

outputs.name: event.job_metadata
outputs.description: Returns metadata captured by the job.

outputs.name: event.job_outcome
outputs.description: Returns the job outcome when one is available.

description: Inspect the state, progress, metadata, and outcome of a canonical Flow job. Missing jobs use the failed output.
examples: Poll this node for job progress, or connect Job Completed when the Flow should resume after terminal completion.

inputs.name: job
inputs.description: Optional job reference to inspect. When supplied, its registered identifier is used.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.description: Optional stable job identifier used when a Job reference is not supplied.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the job status is read.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the requested job does not exist.

outputs.name: job
outputs.description: Returns the registered job reference.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Returns the current job state name.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.description: Returns normalized job progress.

outputs.name: metadata
outputs.description: Returns metadata captured by the job.

outputs.name: outcome
outputs.description: Returns the job outcome when one is available.

outputs.name: completed
outputs.description: Reports whether the job has reached a terminal state.

outputs.name: succeeded
outputs.description: Reports whether the job finished successfully.

outputs.name: cancelled
outputs.description: Reports whether the job was cancelled.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether a job was found for the request.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Returns the stable error code when the lookup fails.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Explains the job lookup result.

description: Request cancellation of a pending or running canonical Flow job. Missing or already terminal jobs use the failed output.
examples: Connect this node to a Flow control path when a pending job should be cancelled.

inputs.name: job
inputs.description: Optional job reference to cancel. When supplied, its registered identifier is used.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.description: Optional stable job identifier used when a Job reference is not supplied.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the cancellation request is accepted.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the job cannot be found or is already terminal.

outputs.name: job
outputs.description: Returns the job reference that received the cancellation request.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns true when the cancellation request is accepted, or a structured failure when it is rejected.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the cancellation request was accepted.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Returns the stable error code when cancellation fails.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Explains the cancellation result.
